title: Wetlands Are Vanishing 3 Times Faster Than Forests
hook: Wetlands lost 35% while forests disappeared far more slowly.
closing: Wetlands buffer floods and clean water, so their faster loss reaches far beyond the marsh.
question: Which wetlands protect your area?

segments.say: Global wetlands fell 35% since 1970, shrinking a natural system that stores water and supports wildlife.
Wetlands disappeared about 3 times faster than forests, overturning the idea that forests are the faster-shrinking landscape.
Europe lost 50% of its wetlands since 1970, showing how severe the decline can become in a single region.
